description.value: Frying Pan is a Korean-style fried chicken brand in Vancouver's West End, serving crispy fried chicken sandwiches, rice bowls, and loaded fries made with halal chicken sourced from local BC farms. The Denman Street dine-in location sits along a well-traveled cycling corridor connecting downtown Vancouver to Stanley Park. The brand also operates a downtown food truck and a catering service, making it a flexible stop for groups of riders.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 70m; stands (4 spaces) at 70m; stands (2 spaces) at 87m. Total: 8 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website confirms an active dine-in and takeout restaurant at 1101 Denman St, Vancouver, matching the OSM record. OSM takeaway=yes is corroborated by the website's 'online pick-up order' option and Uber Eats integration. Vegetarian options (fried tofu) are listed in the menu; however, bike parking, water refill, and washroom details are absent from both the website and OSM tags.
concerns: OSM has no phone number; website contact page lists 236-466-0261 for the Denman St location — added to listing.
OSM opening_hours tag value is 'no', which is an invalid OSM value and likely a data entry error.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The business is clearly active and well-placed on Denman Street, a primary cycling route to Stanley Park, but none of the three required WWC criteria (bike parking/visibility, water refill, washrooms) are confirmed from available evidence. A quick on-site or phone verification would resolve this.
enrichment_extras.notes: Business also operates a second location (food truck) at 505 Burrard St — that is a separate entity and should not be merged with this record.
